basis: 70B03C25P00000029 P00001 deobligates the direct GEO award and says to replace it with 03C25P0150.
70B03C25P00000150 starts on the same day, names County of Val Verde, and performs detention space in Del Rio.
The 2016 county package makes CBP HSBP1016P00342 a rider on USMS IGA 80-98-0061 at the Val Verde facility.
The 2015 county agreement says GEO operates the facility, submits monthly itemized invoices to the county, and the county remits payment to GEO.
GEO's current facility page says GEO was selected to design, build, finance and manage the facility; GEO's 2025 10-K lists the 1,407-bed facility as owned, under a perpetual USMS-IGA.
